contentEn.title: Skol 208A First Line Beach West Facing Duplex Apartment
contentEn.summary: free wifi Attractive, 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom duplex apartment, located on the 2nd floor in Block A, of the Skol building in Marbella. This bright, West facing apartment has sea views, as well as great views over the communal pools and garden
contentEn.description:
free wifi

 

 Attractive, 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom duplex apartment, located on the 2nd floor in Block A, of the Skol building in Marbella. This bright, West facing apartment has sea views, as well as great views over the communal pools and gardens. The popular Skol Complex, is front line beach and right in the heart of Marbella, and 50 meters away from the famous Marbella port. Surrounded by fine dining restaurants and also pubs, bars and shops.

 

 This duplex apartment enjoys evening sun and your stay is guaranteed to be as pleasant as possible. Accommodation comprises; Lift access, entrance, large lounge / dining room with doors to the terrace. Fully fitted kitchen with electric hob, microwave, washing machine.

 

 Upstairs is the master bedroom with two single beds together, a second bedroom with two single beds and a separate full bathroom with shower.

 

 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 

 ❄ Private A/C.

 

 Among the Skol’s facilities are its three unheated outdoors community pools, open all year round. Sunbeds have a cost of €3 per day, and are occupied on a first-come-first-served basis.

 

 Main reception open 24/7 to accommodate late arrivals.

 

 Cafeteria open seasonally, with direct access to the promenade from the community gardens.

 

 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest included in the rental price.

 

 Parking: The property does not have a private parking space. The nearest public car parks are Parking Arias Maldonado and El Molino , which can be booked through APK2 . Please note that APK2 is an independent external company and Marbella Skol is not responsible for its services, availability or pricing.

 

 Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella!
